title: Milestone Invoice Amount — Professional Services Projects
content:
**Professional Services Projects — the amount of a fixed-fee milestone invoice.**

**1. The milestone invoiced.** The milestone invoiced is the highest-numbered milestone recorded complete on the engagement; milestones are recorded complete in schedule order, so two completions recorded on the same day are invoiced in milestone-number order, the higher number last. An engagement with no milestone recorded complete has no milestone invoice. The milestone's completion date is the date it was recorded complete.

**2. Schedule share.** The milestone invoice is the milestone's schedule share of the engagement's contract value, which every signed change order moves by its value change: the class milestone share at that milestone's position, as a percent, times the contract value, rounded half up to the cent. Under every class schedule each milestone but the last carries the largest share in the class milestone shares and the last milestone the smallest, and a class schedule with no milestones has no milestone invoice.

**3. Ceiling.** The milestone invoice before retainage is never more than the contract value less everything already billed by the deposit and milestone invoices, so that progress billing never exceeds the contract value.

**4. Retainage and rounding.** Any retainage withheld from a milestone invoice is a percentage of the milestone invoice before retainage as limited by clause 3; where more than one percentage is withheld they are added together and withheld once. Retainage is never a credit, because the final invoice on acceptance bills it. The milestone invoice is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, Advanced Project shares 25, 25 and 15)

- Contract value 80000.00; the deposit and milestone 1 have billed 40000.00; milestone 2 is recorded complete. Its share is 25 percent of 80000.00, that is 20000.00; the ceiling is 80000.00 less 40000.00, that is 40000.00, so the invoice is 20000.00.
- Contract value moved down to 48000.00 by a signed scope reduction after 40000.00 had been billed; milestone 2's share is 25 percent of 48000.00, that is 12000.00, but the ceiling is 8000.00, so the invoice is 8000.00.
- Milestone 3 is the last milestone of the class and carries the smallest share, 15 percent.
